title: Add PITR backup baseline

context.summary: Add point-in-time recovery support for the local self-host PostgreSQL profile.
context.background: Backups must support WAL archiving and restore to a target time for stronger public self-host reliability.

in: Configure PostgreSQL WAL archiving for the local Compose profile.
Store WAL archives and base backup manifests under MINDORY_HOME/backups.
Add restore-to-time command and validation script.
Document PITR setup, restore and limitations.
Remove TASK-104-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: Local PostgreSQL profile can archive WAL files to MINDORY_HOME.
A base backup plus WAL archive can restore to a requested timestamp.
Restore validation confirms data before and after target time behaves as expected.
Docs explain disk usage and retention requirements.

manual_checks: Confirm PITR commands operate only inside MINDORY_HOME.

risks: PITR restore must never overwrite live data without explicit confirmation.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
